_comment: Venomous Abyss draft. Boss keys = avoidable abilities. '*' = every boss. _ignore = trinkets/enchants/procs to drop from damage stats (self-inflicted damage such as Burning Rush, Stagger, SW:Death is now excluded automatically). Anything under _uncertain is ignored by the tool - it's your checklist: confirm with the 'Cast by' column in the Damage taken tab, then move entries up or delete them.

Nek'zali the Soulcoiler.note: Soulcoil Rite only fires when an add reaches the Well or someone dies in it - that's why it's listed as avoidable even though it's raid-wide.

Entombed Sentinels.note: Empowering Slam / the 99% shield happen when the bosses are too close - a positioning fail, but it's the boss that gets stronger, not players getting hit. Judge from the numbers.

Vashnik the Malignant.note: The three Expulsions/Ejection are the living venoms you are SUPPOSED to intercept - intended damage. Toxic Vapor is probably the room-filling soft enrage.

Nymrissa Wavecaller.note: Not one of the 8 main bosses - probably a rare/mini-boss the logger recorded. Ignore unless you care about it.

The Lost Explorers.note: Final Ascension is the possession soft-enrage - fires when the fish-feeding rotation fails, hence avoidable. Throw Junk / Mushroom Toss may be dodgeable too: check who gets hit.

Sszorak.note: Viscous Cyst is what stops your knockback - stepping on it is CORRECT. Falling (from '*') is the real fail on this boss.

The Twin Fangs.note: Eternal Venom stacks are the fight's core resource - intended, but high stacks are a management fail. Track it in the heatmap rather than flagging it.

The Coiled Altar.note: This is a POSSESSION fight - the hundreds of player spells in the list (Consecration, Flame Shock, Whirlwind...) are your own raiders hitting possessed players. That damage is intended, so it is NOT ignored; the 'Cast by' column shows who. Boss abilities I couldn't place: Coalesced Venom, Dreadful Presence, Spirit Erasure, Soul Sever, Gravebound, Retaliatory Malice, Twinfang Toxin, Pestilence, Virulent Plague, Axegrinder, Guillotine, Suffocating Darkness, Umbral Malignance, Tentacle Slam, Shadowbolt Volley, Void Volley, Concentrated Bile, Crimson Bile, Caustic Spatter, Wrath of Nathreza, Meteor/Meteorites, Stomp. Sort by 'Dmg / pull' and classify the top 10 only - the rest won't matter.

_changelog: 2026-09-21: removed Soulcoil Rite, Caustic Explosion, Caustic Surge, Plague Froth, Venomous Surge, Venom Rupture, Fangs of the Coiled Altar (all hit every raider equally -> raid-wide) and Stone Breaker (tank mechanic). Putrid Membrane and Unchecked Rage are ALSO raid-wide but kept: they only exist after a fail (egg hatched / boss without melee target), so their count per pull IS the fail count. 2026-09-22: the dashboard's who-gets-hit check flagged Cremation, Toxic Droplets, Unstable Miasma, Clinging Murk, Noxious Blast, Congealing Bolt, Blink Nova, Mighty Thud, Raging Crosswinds and Toxic Fumes as raid-wide -> removed. Putrid Membrane and Unchecked Rage still flagged, still kept on purpose (fail-triggered).
